title: Banking account hierarchy
goal: Represent specialized accounts and account-owned financial records.

rubric.must: CheckingAccount, SavingsAccount, and BusinessAccount have hollow-triangle generalization arrows pointing to abstract Account.
Account has filled composition diamonds to LedgerEntry and Statement.
Customer is associated with Account using visible 1 and 0..* multiplicities.
InterestPolicy is visibly an interface and SavingsAccount has a directed association to it.
Account visibly shows protected # number, private - balance, and public + credit operation.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 satisfies all five rules, while Image 2 fails both blockers and omits required associations and Account members.
